_comment: Downstream overrides for ENGINE features, keyed by engine feature id: { "<engine feature id>": { "status": "hidden|disabled|forked", "note": "why, and where the fork lives" } }. hallismiley.is (product hs, role personal) is Halli's portfolio site, not a business instance: the sales, market and customer-billing features the engine grew for Orange Smiley ship in the image (hide, never delete) but have no place in this site's nav or use. tests/unit/featureRegistry.test.js checks every key is an engine feature id.

leads.note: portfolio site — no enquiry pipeline; the contact form mails Halli directly

customer-accounts.note: portfolio site — no B2B customers of record

sales-handbook.note: portfolio site — no sales staff; the engine's seed script (Orange Smiley company copy) ships inert and is never run here

seller-publication.note: portfolio site — INSTANCE_ROLE stays ops (the default), so both seller routes are closed

staff-audit.note: portfolio site — one admin, no staff

peppol-outbound.note: portfolio site — the books are Halli's own; no Peppol counterparties

books-intake.note: portfolio site — no receipt intake queue in use
